quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #24
										  					
  

25 Questions • Passing Score 20

questions.question: If you miss your exit on the freeway, what should you NOT do?

options.text: Continue on the freeway and find another route to your destination.
Go to the next exit, leave the freeway, and return to your correct exit.
Back up on the road or shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Back up on the road or shoulder.
questions.explanation: Never back up on the road or shoulder if you miss your exit. Keep driving to the next exit or crossroad. Other drivers will not expect you to back up, and this can cause a crash.

questions.question: When you cannot see well while driving, what should you do first?

options.text: Turn on your headlights.
Slow down.
Turn on your windshield wipers.
Look for road edge markings to guide you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down.
questions.explanation: Slowing down should be your first response when visibility is poor or road conditions are dangerous.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Divided highway.
Railroad warning.
No passing zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: Divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a divided highway is starting ahead.

questions.question: When an oncoming car has bright headlights shining at you, what should you do?

options.text: Turn your bright lights on until the other driver dims theirs.
Flash your lights on and off to warn the other driver.
Dim your lights and speed up to pass quickly.
Look toward the right side of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look toward the right side of the road.
questions.explanation: Look away from the bright headlights and toward the right side of the road until the car passes. This will protect your eyes from being blinded.

questions.question: You are approaching an intersection with a steady yellow light. If you have not entered the intersection yet, you should:

options.text: Speed up to cross before the red light.
Slow down and carefully drive through the intersection.
Stop safely.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop safely.
questions.explanation: When you see a steady yellow light, prepare to stop. If you are already in the intersection, drive through it quickly.

questions.question: When you approach a railroad crossing with no flashing lights or gates, you should:

options.text: Cross the tracks as fast as possible.
Always stop before crossing the tracks.
Be ready to yield to any train.
Speed up to cross before a train arrives.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to yield to any train.
questions.explanation: Always be prepared to stop and yield to trains at any crossing, especially when there are no lights or gates. Never start crossing until your entire vehicle can fit on the other side of the tracks. Do not change gears while crossing because your vehicle might stall.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep right.
Low shoulder.
No parking at any time.
Lane ends.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep right.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers to stay in the right lane to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: Traffic signals show arrows to control turns from certain lanes. A solid red arrow means:

options.text: It is never used in traffic signals.
It means the same thing as a circular red traffic light.
You may turn in the direction the arrow points.
Traffic in that direction must stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: It means the same thing as a circular red traffic light.
questions.explanation: A solid red arrow means the same as a circular red light. You must stop and cannot turn in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: You should increase your following distance behind a large vehicle to:

options.text: See around the sides of the vehicle better.
Stop other drivers from pulling in before they pass.
Avoid getting caught in the vehicle's slipstream.

questions.correctAnswerText: See around the sides of the vehicle better.
questions.explanation: Drivers of large vehicles cannot see cars directly behind them. Increase your distance so you can see around the sides of the vehicle and see the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrian crossing.
School crossing.
Jogging trail.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pedestrian crossing.
questions.explanation: This yellow sign warns drivers to watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: Is it correct to use high beam headlights when driving in fog?

options.text: TRUE
FALSE

questions.correctAnswerText: FALSE
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights in fog. High beams reflect off the fog and shine back into your eyes, making it harder to see.

questions.question: As a pedestrian, you should:

options.text: Always insist on the right-of-way over vehicles in a crosswalk.
Never enter a street or crosswalk when vehicles are coming toward you.
Enter a crosswalk anytime because drivers must stop for you.
Use crosswalks only when it is convenient.

questions.correctAnswerText: Never enter a street or crosswalk when vehicles are coming toward you.
questions.explanation: Do not enter a street or crosswalk when vehicles are approaching. Even though pedestrians have the right-of-way in crosswalks, a vehicle that is close may not have time to stop.

questions.question: When can you cross a solid yellow line?

options.text: To pass other traffic going the same direction.
Only during daylight hours.
Anytime you want to.
When you are making a turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: When you are making a turn.
questions.explanation: Broken lines can be crossed, but solid lines cannot. You may cross a solid yellow line only when turning.

questions.question: What does a broken yellow line next to a solid yellow line mean?

options.text: You can pass from either direction.
You can pass from the lane with the broken line.
You can pass from the lane with the solid line.
You cannot pass from either direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can pass from the lane with the broken line.
questions.explanation: A broken yellow line next to a solid yellow line means passing is allowed only from the side with the broken line.

questions.question: What is a "No zone"?

options.text: A no passing zone
A one-way traffic area
The blind spot around a large truck or vehicle
An area for motor vehicles only

questions.correctAnswerText: The blind spot around a large truck or vehicle
questions.explanation: "No zones" are the large blind spots around trucks and big vehicles. Stay out of these areas when driving near large vehicles.

questions.question: For drivers 21 and older, what is the legal limit for blood alcohol concentration (BAC)?

options.text: 0.05 percent
0.08 percent
0.02 percent
0.1 percent

questions.correctAnswerText: 0.08 percent
questions.explanation: Drivers 21 and older cannot drive with a blood alcohol concentration (BAC) of 0.08 percent or higher. Driving under the influence is illegal and dangerous.

questions.question: When passing a car that just parked on the side of the road, you should:

options.text: Assume the driver will open the door as you pass.
Speed up.
Brake suddenly.
Assume the driver will wait for you to pass before opening the door.

questions.correctAnswerText: Assume the driver will open the door as you pass.
questions.explanation: When passing a parked car, assume the driver may open the door as you approach. Drive carefully near parked vehicles.

questions.question: Is it unlawful for a car to share a lane with a motorcycle?

options.text: TRUE
FALSE

questions.correctAnswerText: TRUE
questions.explanation: Motorcyclists have the right to use a full lane. Two motorcycles can share a lane, but cars cannot share a lane with motorcycles.

questions.question: A solid white line on the right edge of the road angles toward the left. What does this mean?

options.text: An intersection is ahead.
A construction area is ahead.
You must turn left ahead.
The road will get narrower.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will get narrower.
questions.explanation: The solid line on the side of the road marks the road's edge. When this line angles toward the center, it means the road is getting narrower ahead.

questions.question: When should you give up your right-of-way?

options.text: Often, even at controlled intersections.
Whenever it helps prevent a crash.
Never, because it confuses other drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Whenever it helps prevent a crash.
questions.explanation: Never assume other drivers will give you the right-of-way. Give up your right-of-way whenever it helps prevent a crash.

questions.question: If you want to enter the freeway but do not see a gap in traffic, what should you do?

options.text: Keep your speed and force other drivers to make a gap.
Slow down on the ramp and wait for a gap.
Stop at the end of the ramp and wait for a gap.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down on the ramp and wait for a gap.
questions.explanation: Slow down on the ramp to wait for a gap. If you wait at the end of the ramp, you will not have enough room to speed up to match the freeway traffic before entering.

questions.question: As you approach the top of a hill, what should you do?

options.text: Speed up a little.
Get ready to stop if needed.
Keep a steady speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Get ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: You cannot see what is beyond a hill or around a curve, even on roads you know well. A vehicle could be stopped just out of sight. Adjust your speed so you can stop if necessary when approaching hills or curves.

questions.question: When driving in bad weather, what should drivers do?

options.text: Speed up to reach their destination faster.
Follow the car ahead more closely.
Stay farther behind the car ahead.
None of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay farther behind the car ahead.
questions.explanation: In bad weather and on wet roads, increase the distance between your car and the car ahead of you.

questions.question: What color are road markings that separate traffic moving in opposite directions?

options.text: Yellow
White
Yellow and white
Yellow, white, and black

questions.correctAnswerText: Yellow
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic lanes that move in opposite directions.

questions.question: If you park facing uphill on a street with a curb, set the parking brake and then:

options.text: Turn the front wheels toward the curb.
Turn the front wheels away from the curb.
Leave the front wheels straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn the front wheels away from the curb.
questions.explanation: When parking uphill on a street with a curb, turn the wheels away from the curb. When parking uphill on a street without a curb or when parking downhill, turn the wheels toward the curb or edge.
